# `capability` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "capability" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/capability/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Group id, e.g. "sorcerer-spells". Capabilities are keyed by their id. |
| `name` | string | required | Display name of the group (docs and debug tools). |
| `notes` | string | required | What the group covers and where it comes from, for review. |
| `capabilities` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The capabilities it declares. |
| `capabilities[].id` | string | required | Capability id: verb., spell., arrow., tool., trick., technique. or sense. then a name. |
| `capabilities[].name` | string | required | Display name, e.g. "Mage Hand". |
| `capabilities[].description` | string | required | What the capability lets the player do in the world, for designers and review. |
